title: Colored Noise
text: Generate colored noise signal, 1 output, {Noise color} sets Color of the generated noise; {Power of inverse frequency} sets the inverse power spectral density component, {Guarantee the output is bounded (+/-1)} sets the output bounds to +1 and −1, {Number of output channels}, {Output data type}, {Number of samples per output channel} sets the samples per frame of output, {Output sample time (s)} sets the sample time of the output, {Initial seed} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Colored noise signal scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Noise color
params.values: Color of the generated noise pink (default) | white | brown | blue | purple | custom

params.name: Power of inverse frequency
params.values: Inverse power spectral density component 1 (default) | scalar in the range [-2 2]

params.name: Guarantee the output is bounded (+/-1)
params.values: Set output bounds to +1 and −1 off (default) | on

params.name: Number of output channels
params.values: Number of output channels 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Number of samples per output channel
params.values: Samples per frame of output 1024 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Output sample time (s)
params.values: Sample time of the output 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Initial seed
params.values: Initial seed of random number generator 67 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
